articles.detail: 5 cycles scheduled, 3 published (avg 15/cycle); 04:00 and 17:00 produced zero

experiment: Skipped — every goal metric is inside target, no experiment is active, and no pause gate applies. The day's two failures are pipeline faults, not parameter faults; no tunable in the daily-tuning scope would have prevented either, and adding a variable now would only muddy the baseline against which the writer flake needs measuring.
weakestArea: Cycle completion, not any content metric. Three of five cycles published: 04:00 lost its writer to a sandbox refusal ('File access to /tmp/zuhd-selection.json is blocked in this session') on both the first attempt and the retry, and 17:00 wrote and validated 12 articles that were then thrown away when build.js died with ENOENT writing dist/a/2026-07-30-damietta-drone-confirmed-cause-withheld-attribution.html. That is roughly 24 articles lost. Behind the content numbers, source breadth is the softest: unique sources fell 43 to 28 while output fell only 55 to 46, and CoinDesk sits at 7 articles (15%) alongside Dawn at 7 — both under the 20% ceiling, but the concentration is tighter than any day this week.
watching: Writer /tmp refusals are now a pattern, not a one-off: 08-01 12:00, 08-03 17:02, 08-06 04:04 and 08-08 04:01 all hit it, and two of those four cost the whole cycle. The existing did-it-write-an-article retry fires correctly but re-issues an identical prompt, so it reproduces the same refusal.

build.js ENOENT on dist/a/*.html at scripts/build.js:1775 — first occurrence in the log history, and the 22:00 cycle built cleanly, so it is transient. The mkdirSync for dist/a runs immediately above the write loop, which makes a concurrent removal of dist/ the likelier cause than a missing directory.
The 04:00 cycle also logged a post-dedup floor violation (economy 1 < 3) before the writer failed, so that cycle was thin upstream as well as broken downstream.

Sci-tech at 48% is the highest this week (35% yesterday) and tech at 12 outran politics-adjacent output; healthy against the 25% floor, but a swing this wide in one day is mix noise rather than a trend.
coverageGaps: Oceania produced zero articles for a second consecutive day; Africa at 3 is down from 6 and is the thinnest non-empty bucket.
One story carried a 'GL' (global) region tag rather than a dateline region, which neither helps nor hurts the six-bucket count but hides where the story actually sits.
Only 3 multi-source clusters reached the 17:00 feed against 59 niche items, so multi-source supply upstream stayed at the low end of its usual 8–14 range.
context: Output held at 46 articles despite losing two of five cycles, because the three that ran published 10, 12 and the balance. Average cycle duration fell 1174s to 826s, with the selector at 250s, writer 221s and editor 104s — all far inside their timeouts. Freshness held at a 0.6-day median. The experiment slate is empty and the queued numerical-density experiment remains blocked on its own preflight (replicate the bench gain at n>=20 first); it targets scripts/write-prompt.md, which is outside daily-tuning scope regardless. Both of today's failures live in scripts/run-cycle.sh and scripts/build.js, also outside that scope — the writer refusal in particular looks addressable by granting the writer session explicit access to /tmp rather than relying on the retry, but that is an operator call.
